• Even Minkowski uniqueness as a consequence of logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski
    6 October 2026 · Zenodo display edition: v1 · Unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint

    Two distinct uniqueness consequences: smooth positive even data for 0≤p<1, and arbitrary origin-symmetric bodies with equal unnormalized Lp measures for 0<p<1.

    PDF · Zenodo

  • Hypersingular Riesz-energy constants on surfaces from triangular-lattice universal optimality
    6 October 2026 · Version 1.0.0 · Unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint

    An attributed consequence of triangular-lattice universal optimality: exact leading Riesz-energy constants on smooth surfaces for each fixed s > 2.

    PDF · Zenodo

  • Rational Hodge classes on mixed products of K3 moduli spaces
    6 October 2026 · Unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint

    An attributed corollary for rational Hodge classes on mixed products of smooth projective stable K3 moduli spaces, using OpenAI and Bülles.

    PDF · Zenodo
